## Release Notes

### New Features

#### Middleware

* Added CORS middleware support to simplify cross-origin request handling.

#### Build & Deployment

* Optimized the build script for improved development and deployment efficiency.

#### Cache Management

* Added support for running without a default cache file configuration.

#### Logging

* Added an option to skip printing route prefix logs for cleaner startup output.

#### Static File Serving

* Added configuration support to control whether directory file listings are returned.
* Added support for injecting file content and returning file lists dynamically.

### Improvements

* Enhanced flexibility and configurability for static file handling.
* Improved application startup and deployment experience through configurable logging and build optimizations.
